text:
1. 1. 6

Bhikkhusuttaṃ

6. Sāvatthiyaṃ:

Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: "brahmacariyaṃ brahmacariya"nti bhante, vuccati, katamannu kho bhante, brahmacariyaṃ? Katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti? Ayameva kho bhikkhu, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṃ. Seyyathīdaṃ: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi. yo kho bhikkhu, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo imaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti.
